Create an SS3 run with effort creep in the indices of abundance

Source: R/AddEffortCreep.R
AddEffortCreep.Rd

Copies the SS3 input files of an existing run and deflates the index observations for an assumed annual increase in fishing efficiency (effort creep): obs_y / (1 + creep)^(y - ref_year). With a separate catchability for each index, only the trend matters, so ref_year only rescales q.

Usage

AddEffortCreep(from, to, creep, fleets = NULL, ref_year = NULL)

Arguments

from

character. Directory of the SS3 run to copy the input files from

to

character. Directory of the new SS3 run. Created if it doesn't exist

creep

numeric. Annual effort creep, e.g. 0.01 for 1% per year

fleets

optional numeric vector. Fleet numbers of the indices to adjust. NULL (default) adjusts all indices in the data file

ref_year

optional numeric. Year with no adjustment. NULL (default) uses the first year of each index

Value

invisibly, a data.frame with the adjustment for each fleet
